title: 9.6.1 | Bugfix Patch
body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/e0b19e3412fd9a109cf80a22c1416a7944360000.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Diminishing Returns Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Diminishing Returns section in the Game Manual updated.[/p][list][*][p]Now lists all Action Speeds and Modifiers affected by Diminishing Returns in a Trial.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/AF1BD6OS1JO7/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Progress Bar Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the arrows animation on the progress bar to better reflect the speed of the bar filling.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/80P459ZT9A5B/bar-red.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]The Doctor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased delay of Shock Therapy attack to [b]0.65 seconds[/b]. [i](was 0.75 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]The Ghost Face[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased default Crouch movement speed to [b]4.0 m/s[/b]. [i](was 3.8 m/s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/Z1UKH9KBL3X3/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Add-ons Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"][b]The Doctor's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]"Discipline" - Class II (Uncommon)[/p][list][*][p]Decreases the detonation delay of Shock Therapy by [b]0.06 seconds[/b]. [i](was 0.1 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]"Discipline" - Class III (Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Decreases the detonation delay of Shock Therapy by [b]0.08 seconds[/b]. [i](was 0.15 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]"Discipline" - Carter's Notes (Very Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Decreases the detonation delay of Shock Therapy by [b]0.1 seconds[/b]. [i](was 0.2 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/CHZ6XKEAQJX2/bar-white.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2v8[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The core changes to Mastermind are now applied in 2v8. The time it takes to gain a Bound token has been increased to maintain balancing (5s → 5.5s).[/p][p align="start"][b]The Mastermind Innate Skill[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increases time to gain a Bound token by 0.5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/9G04O52HRSV1/bar-red.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]2v8[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Dark Lord's castle was missing with 4 specific Killers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Antidote item was held horizontally or clipped inside the Survivor's arm when facing The Mastermind and The Nemesis.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Scout was able to reveal the Killer's aura regardless of the distance to all Survivors within 64 meters of the Killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the movement speed from Scout class stacked when applied to a crouching Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Torchbearer was unable to use its Team skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Escapist Team Skill ability was unable to give the Haste bonus after another Survivor was Sacrificed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were able to relocate infinitely during the End Game Collapse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the 2v8 Event Entry Overview popup Play buttons were placeholder in several languages.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Trickster's laugh was not heard across the map when reaching S-Rank.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where subtitles for Stranger Things characters' French VO's were incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The First's voice lines are missing when reaching the last quarter of the Doomclock while Grandfather Clocks are unused by all Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Eleven couching grunts for French VO's were too loud.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where MiNA's lullaby can be heard during the Mori.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Killers equipped with Blighted outfits were missing customization SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some specific sounds related to Killer Power were sometime louder than ordinary.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Menu music was unbalanced between different menus and music cues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Good Guy's attack swing audio could be heard twice when preparing a lunge attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Ghoul's SFX was too loud.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain Killer SFX and actions were too loud.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bot Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with AI characters being unable to traverse the top of one of the stairs in Hawkins National Laboratory.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's head detaches during the Hook animation in Head Form.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's Axe Throw was unable to be tracked by the Chaser score event on damaging hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's Grab Axe could cause a desync when performed on Survivors entering Lockers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's Grab Axe action did not appear if Survivors were too close to the Killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Survivors' cough was silent when hiding in a locker while infected by The Nemesis' T-Virus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Dark Lord's Hellfire Spell VFX stayed in the Killer's hand after the Killer Power was cancelled by a Pallet Stun.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight was unable to see noise notifications for cleansed totems when in Guard Summon mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Survivors' footsteps VFX were missing when above a Xenomorph Tunnel, and where an Aura was missing between the Control Station and the Exit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Executioner's 1st instance of Trail of Torment could spawn at another nearby location where Trail of Torment had been used earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an Item was unable to be in a Survivor's Back Pocket when Picking Up the Lich's Eye or Hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after Scampering, The Good Guy's camera could become corrupted and lock into place for the duration of the trial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors slammed in a corner by The Mastermind were blocked by The Mastermind's collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind was able to cancel the special vault fatigue with a basic attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind had no remaining momentum when pressing a directional input while hitting a collision with Virulent Bound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Mastermind was able to grab Survivors with Virulent Bound while they were dropping pallets. (tentative fix)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Trickster ''Frosty Eyes'' Head Outfit caused texture issues when swapping from another head outfit.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Dead Dawg Saloon where The Nightmare could not teleport properly to a generator on a balcony in the back of a structure.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Trickster's Delusion where Killers would get stuck on a collision on a food cart.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where projectiles of Killers would be blocked by a collision above the fire barrels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Pale Rose where the navigation of players were hindered by the placement of a Xenomorph tunnel entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Disturbed Ward where The Nurse could blink on top of the structure.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where a Survivor clips through a locker when entering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Sanctum of Wrath where The Plague's projectile would be blocked by an invisible collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Raccoon City Police Station - West Side where The Trapper's Trap would clip through the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Toba Landing map by creating LODs for plants to avoid LOD popping throughout the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Exit Gates opening was slightly delayed after playing more then 1 match.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Obsession changed to another Survivor when Dramaturgy gave a key with the Wedding Ring Key add-on to the Obsession.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Regurgitate removed a token from the Perk Play with Your Food.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Chemical Trap used the Marked Aura type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Wire Tap used the Marked Aura type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Bada Bada Boom used the Marked Aura type.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Reassurance was unable to be reapplied to a Survivor that previously used the Anti-Camp Self unhook.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Game Afoot incorrectly applied the Haste Status Effect on Wall Special Break.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an Injured Survivor's aura was revealed inside a Locker with the Boon: Circle of Healing Perk.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players were randomly disconnected by server.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain assets and Killer Powers with a white default aura appeared in a purple aura.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players were unable to complete the Achievement 'Collision Course'.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could have duplicate of the same friends in friends list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could select two friends at the same time in the friends list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could not add new friends on certain platforms.[/p][/*][/list]
